about_the_game:
HISTORICAL INVESTIGATION POWERED BY LEGENDARY VOICES

Experience a faithful adaptation of Catherine Lheureux’s acclaimed detective novel. A deep immersion into 1799 France, brought to life by an all-star French voice cast featuring Martial Le Minoux (Professor Layton), Patrick Borg (Goku), Mark Lesser (Trunks) and many more. (Full English subtitles included).

July 1799. Moha, near Huy, in the French department of Ourthe.

The body of Nicolas Richelle, the village priest, is discovered at the presbytery: the man was tortured before being murdered. The premises have been ransacked.

You play as Captain Grégoire Lefèbvre, an officer of the horse gendarmerie on his first mission in the region. He is tasked with investigating this murder, which echoes other brutal attacks carried out around Huy.

The victim was a "constitutional priest"—one of those who accepted the Republic's authority against the Pope's wishes—and his parishioners hated him. A robbery gone wrong? Revenge? Or something far darker?

Does the solution lie in Richelle's own shadow? What role did the Chevalier de Mélotte, a hot-tempered country gentleman, play in the drama?

From the start, the investigation promises to be difficult, caught between the friends and foes of the murdered priest.

What are they hiding? It’s up to you to find out.

FEATURES

  • Narrative Point-and-Click : A classic adventure set in Directory-era Belgium (1799).

  • Deep Investigation : Question witnesses, inspect crime scenes, and gather evidence to solve the mystery.

  • Literary Script : A plot faithful to Catherine Lheureux's novel "Le Serment de Haine" (The Vow of Hate). Discover the first adventure of the Grégoire Lefèbvre saga.

  • Premium Voice Acting : Entirely dubbed in French by legendary professional actors for total immersion.

  • Accessibility : Full interface and subtitles available in both French and English.

📝 Don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist to support a solo developer!
